messages:
anna_ml: Uploaded new model bundle: sable-6b-lite (weights + tokenizer). Placed in s3://redwood-ingest/sable-6b/2026-03-20/
devon_ops: Nice. Do we have sha256 & KMS envelope? Link the manifest.
anna_ml: Yup. Manifest and signed checksum uploaded. KMS key used: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
anna_ml: checksum command I ran:
```bash
sha256sum weights.tar.gz > weights.sha256
aws s3 cp weights.tar.gz s3://redwood-ingest/sable-6b/2026-03-20/
aws s3 cp weights.sha256 s3://redwood-ingest/sable-6b/2026-03-20/
```
maria_research: Quick QA request: can we prioritize quantization experiments before full rollout? This looks like a latency-sensitive workload.
sahil_ml: +1 for quant-first. Proposed flow:
  1) Verify manifest & tokenizer smoke load on a small CPU/GPU test host
  2) Run 4-bit and 8-bit quantization trials (QAT not needed) — use our quant-runner pipeline
  3) Run eval suite (toxicity, instruction-following, perf on dev prompt set)
  4) If regressions < threshold -> bake into canary pool
  5) Monitor P50/P95 token latency and bleu/accuracy deltas
devon_ops: Sounds good. Who takes step 1 & the registry entries?
anna_ml: I can do step 1 + registry write. Planning to add a provenance entry under /registry/models/sable-6b/2026-03-20/ with fields: origin, sha256, kms_key, signer, acquisition_ticket.
ingest-bot: Automated note: registry entry template available at /ops/templates/model-registry-template.json
maria_research: For prioritization — set label: P2 (quant/BENCH) unless product requests urgent.
sahil_ml: I'll kick off quant runs. ETA 2 days for initial 4-bit/8-bit pass.
anna_ml: Smoke load commands (use small test instance):
```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('s3://redwood-ingest/sable-6b/2026-03-20/tokenizer')
model = AutoModel.from_pretrained('s3://redwood-ingest/sable-6b/2026-03-20/weights')
print('loaded', model.config)
```
devon_ops: Registry write checklist: ensure S3 lifecycle TTL, block public access, add kms key policy, tag with team=ml and cost_center=research
anna_ml: Done — added TTL 180d, tags, and policy. Pushed manifest: s3://model-registry/sable-6b/2026-03-20/manifest.json
maria_research: Test plan note: include the regression harness from /evals/instruction-following/v2 and our perf prompts from perf-suite/small-chat
sahil_ml: Will log experiment ids back here when runs start. Also planning to try mixed-quant fallback (8->4) if quality drops.
anna_ml: Thanks. If anyone spots checksum mismatch msg me. Otherwise move to quant stage.
devon_ops: thumbs up :thumbsup:
